newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices narrowly mixed.

text.p: U.S. crude oil futures were narrowly mixed in overnight ACCESS trade Thursday, as thin volume left prices with little direction, traders said.
Despite a bullish API report Thursday, U.S. crude oil futures lost strength during the day session, shedding six points to $24.18, the same level traded on ACCESS several hours into the session.
Traders liquidated their March positions for April late in the day and profit-taking continued to hit the overnight market, brokers said.
ACCESS activity stood at a light 455 lots traded in March and 700 overall.
NYMEX February heating oil rose 0.05 cents a gallon to 66.40 cents a gallon, with about 64 lots traded in the front month and 180 traded overall.
Gasoline futures edged down by 0.02 cents to 68.40 cents a gallon, with 60 lots traded in the nearby month and 70 exchanged overall.
